reason: In discourse/models/group.js:259, findMembers caps the offset using the local user_count, which still holds the count from before the removal. With limit 50 and 51 members, removing the only member on page 2 refetches with offset 50. The server returns no members and meta.offset 50 (groups_controller.rb:686-698), and admin-group.js.es6:12-20 then shows page 2/2 with an empty list.
